notes: Read the complete labor unit, full preceding labor-policy context, all twenty candidates and the review. Split each paired labor benefit or program into discrete assertions while retaining that the whole list is characterized as cornerstones of middle-class security. Restored public-sector scope to every listed occupation and retained the source's characterization of those public jobs as a proven path to the middle class.

claims.claim_text: Union work resulted in the forty-hour workweek.
Union work resulted in paid leave.
Union work resulted in the minimum wage.
Union work resulted in health insurance.
Union work resulted in Social Security.
The forty-hour week, weekends, paid leave, pensions, the minimum wage, health insurance, Social Security and Medicare are characterized as cornerstones of middle-class security.

Democrats would fight for collective-bargaining rights for public-sector police officers, nurses, firefighters, emergency medical technicians, teachers and other public workers, whose jobs are described as a proven middle-class path for millions of Americans.
